text: I'm very sorry to be ringing round at this time of night, I hope this is the right number. My granddaughter is 11 months and her temperature is 38.5. She was sick once earlier this evening but she's kept her drinks down since then, no more sickness. There's no rash on her at all, I've looked her over properly. She's wide awake actually, sat up watching the telly and babbling away to me, which is more than I am! Her mum and dad are away so I'm a bit out of my depth. Is there anything I should be watching for, or is it alright to wait till the morning?
